settings_easter_title: For the person who kept building
settings_easter_body:
If you found this page, thank you.

There were many moments during this project when I wanted to quit: blocked progress, repeated bugs, and rebuilds that started from scratch. But step by step, I kept going.

Anoxia is still growing, but every fix and every adjustment has one goal: to help important words arrive safely and clearly. I hope it makes your everyday conversations a little lighter.
settings_easter_signature: For everyone who almost gave up, but kept going

official_room_faq_q1: How do I hide the official help entry?
official_room_faq_a1: Turn off "Show official help" in Settings > General. It can be re-enabled at any time.
official_room_faq_q2: How do I use the AI assistant?
official_room_faq_a2: Select text in the input box, or right-click / long-press a message and choose Explain / Summarize / Translate / Polish / Expand. Custom instructions are supported, and smart replies suggest several options.
official_room_faq_a3: Yes. The "E2E encryption enabled" indicator means end-to-end encryption is active. Hosts can mute or remove participants.
official_room_faq_q4: What if I sent a message by mistake?
official_room_faq_a4: Right-click / long-press your message and choose Recall, or forward it to the right conversation. Favorite important content before sending.
official_room_faq_q5: How do I customize the theme?
official_room_faq_a5: Settings > Appearance offers 14 accent colors plus custom color picking, and light / dark mode.
